intro.text: A Lurcher in the Set, known only by the nickname Pull, who works in a pair with a Coinshot called Push.

items.text: Pull and his partner Push dressed alike and worked heists and other jobs together for the Set. Mister Suit assigned the pair to back up Miles Dagouter's Vanishers in their robberies and kidnappings, to guard Suit and to deal with any meddling from Wax.

When Wax stowed away on a train that was about to be stolen, Miles warned the pair he was likely aboard. Wax slipped their ambush with a dynamite diversion, and they chased him up the Ironspine Building. Pull turned Wax's shots aside with Allomancy, but as he followed him down, Marasi hit him with an aluminum rifle round and he fell to his death.

appearance.text: A black suit over a bulletproof metal breastplate, and at least one handgun.

personality.text: He says little, if anything at all.
